answer_1.quote: Evaluating the factuality of long-form LLM responses is a challenging task...

answer_2.quote: We report three key factual evaluation metrics: (i) Precision measures the proportion of correct facts... (ii) Recall assesses the proportion of reference facts... (iii) F1 balances precision and recall...

answer_3.quote: To automate the detection of incomplete and missing facts, we employ three LLMs (GPT-4o, Llama 3.3-70B, Qwen 2.5-32B) to replicate the annotation process...

answer_4.quote: Based on our manual analysis, we categorize incomplete facts... We employ four annotators... to identify incomplete and missing facts... with each fact independently annotated by all four.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators identify incomplete facts (ambiguous concept, missing comparandum, omitted condition) and missing facts (temporal/contingency relations) using word-mapping algorithms and confidence-based merging
